name: How should I prepare for plumbing updates before a major remodel?

mainEntity.name: How should I prepare for plumbing updates before a major remodel?

acceptedAnswer.text: Before consulting your general contractor, determine your desired layout, list any existing plumbing issues, and select appliance specifications. Note problems like low water pressure, slow-draining lines, or clogs, which can indicate broader pipe or sewer issues. If you plan to add high-flow appliances, pot fillers, or multi-head walk-in showers, share the manufacturer specification sheets. Gathering these details early helps your contractor and project manager assess pipe capacity and design appropriate plumbing lines without project delays.
acceptedAnswer.description: Document recurring drainage or pressure issues, outline fixture layout goals, and collect spec sheets for high-demand fixtures like body sprays or pot fillers.
